description: Assemblyman Matt Slater (R,C-Yorktown) recently celebrated Yorktown Tire Auto Care’s recognition on the New York State Historic Business Preservation Registry, honoring the family-owned business for more than 55 years of dedicated service to motorists throughout Yorktown and the Hudson Valley. Slater also issued a New York State Assembly proclamation recognizing the business’s longstanding commitment to quality automotive care, customer service and the local community.For more than five decades,
